description: This file declares functions, macros, and types related to X509 certificate handling within an SSL/TLS framework, including creation, loading, freeing certificates, and setting CA certifications in SSL contexts.

methods.name: __X509_new
methods.description: Creates a new X509 certificate object based on an existing one.

methods.name: X509_new
methods.description: Creates a new, empty X509 certificate object.

methods.name: d2i_X509
methods.description: Loads an X509 certificate from DER-encoded data.

methods.name: SSL_CTX_add_client_CA
methods.description: Adds a client CA certificate to the SSL context.

methods.name: SSL_add_client_CA
methods.description: Adds a client CA certificate to the SSL connection.

methods.name: SSL_use_certificate_ASN1
methods.description: Loads a certificate into SSL from ASN.1 DER-encoded data.

methods.name: X509_verify_cert_error_string
methods.description: Returns a human-readable error string for a certificate verification error code.
